issue.title: Rebaseline 7 stale ACE PNG goldens left by landed UI changes (artifacts split, help filter, models-panel navigation)
issue.description:
Seven ACE PNG snapshot goldens fail deterministically in the dedicated serial visual lane on clean master f8b4ebb11, and no active epic owns the commits that changed them.

REPRODUCTION (workspace sase_14, clean master f8b4ebb11, after a from-scratch 'just install'):
  .venv/bin/pytest -q -n 0 -m visual tests/ace/tui/visual/
  -> 16 failed, 681 passed, 14 deselected in 1506.01s (0:25:06)

Serial (-n 0), so this is not xdist contention.

THE SEVEN NODES THIS BEAD OWNS:
  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py::test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[narrow-size0-artifacts_split_narrow_120x40]
  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py::test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[even-size1-artifacts_split_even_120x40]
  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py::test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[wide-size2-artifacts_split_wide_120x40]
  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py::test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot[narrow-size3-artifacts_split_narrow_80x24]
  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_help_panel.py::test_help_panel_filter_png_snapshot
  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_navigation.py::test_models_panel_bucket_drilled_in_png_snapshot
  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_navigation.py::test_models_panel_mixed_builtin_bucket_png_snapshot

The other nine failures from the same run are already owned and are NOT in scope here: four retry-e2e nodes -> sase-dc; one Artifacts Files node -> sase-my (an AttributeError before any PNG comparison, not a golden diff); three Artifacts Beads nodes -> recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on active epic sase-nb; one AXE chop-overrun node -> recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on active epic sase-jx.

EVIDENCE OF SCALE (.pytest_cache/sase-visual/*/summary.txt): help_keymaps_filter_120x40 changed 681/1520532 pixels (0.0448%), all 681 material, expected and actual both 1482x1026. Small, single-label-shaped diffs like this one match the stale-text signature rather than renderer variance.

LIKELY CAUSE: recent UI commits landed without regenerating goldens. Candidates, none owned by an active epic: 3f5378aeb 'feat(artifacts): conform pane contract capabilities' (closed epic sase-m6, phase sase-m6.10) for the four artifacts_split nodes; 83e2ceea6 'feat(ace): unify monitor gear iconography across nodes and the top bar' (tale plan 202608/monitor_gear_iconography.md, no bead) and 3c9df1182 'feat(ace-tui)!: unify the Artifacts keymap across Patch and its siblings' for the help-panel and models-panel-navigation chrome. Note that epic sase-m6's coordinated golden regeneration plus 563a67fb0 already rebaselined the 41-node models-panel drift tracked by the now-closed sase-nq; these two navigation nodes survived that pass and are a later, distinct drift.

SCOPE: for each of the seven, inspect the expected/actual/diff artifacts and confirm the change is confined to intentional text or chrome from a landed commit (no scattered anti-aliasing noise, which would instead indicate renderer variance and belongs with the retired sase-dl class). Rebaseline only the confirmed-intentional goldens with --sase-update-visual-snapshots; investigate rather than accept any node whose diff is not explained by a landed UI change. Do NOT run 'just test-visual-update' broadly -- closed sase-lo records that it rewrites every golden in the suite and silently absorbs unrelated drift. Verify with a serial 'just test-visual' afterward.

IMPACT: contained. The PNG suite is excluded from both 'just test' and 'just test-cost', so 'just check' and 'just check-full' stay green and no landing agent is blocked. This is filed because the cause here is tractable and code-attributable -- stale goldens from identified commits, fixable by a scoped rebaseline -- which is a different class from the renderer/environment variance the owner deprioritized on 2026-08-14 when closing sase-l8 and sase-dl.

DISCOVERED BY: the task-bead triage agent sweeping the sase task backlog on 2026-08-16, while verifying whether sase-np/sase-nq were still reproducible (they were not, and both were closed).

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-dl — retired broad ACE PNG baseline-drift umbrella, closed 2026-08-12 as deprioritized renderer/font/environment variance. Read its close reason before working this: it is the class this bead is deliberately NOT, and its instruction is to reopen only if drift reaches a gate that blocks landing. If any of these seven diffs turns out to be scattered sub-pixel noise rather than changed text/chrome, it belongs to that class and should not be rebaselined here.

RELATED: sase-lo — 'just test-visual-update rewrites every PNG golden in the suite, silently absorbing unrelated drift'. Directly constrains the fix mechanism for this bead: update only the seven named goldens, never the whole suite.

RELATED: sase-my — the eighth still-red visual node from the same run, kept separate because it errors with an AttributeError during setup (a stale monkeypatch target after the Files pane split) and is not a golden diff at all; regenerating goldens cannot fix it.

RELATED: sase-dc — owns the four tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py nodes from the same run. Worth reading: sase-dc's description says those four PASS in the dedicated just test-visual lane and fail only under full-suite contention, but in this serial -n 0 run all four failed, so that bead's premise has drifted.

RELATED: sase-nq — closed 2026-08-16 after verification that epic sase-m6's coordinated golden regeneration plus 563a67fb0 cleared the 41-node models-panel keymap-rename drift. The two models_panel_navigation nodes in this bead survived that rebaseline, which is the evidence that they are a later and distinct drift.

SCOPE WIDENING (triage sweep 2026-08-17, workspace sase_12, clean master cf7eeee03 after a from-scratch 'just install'): this bead now owns 11 nodes, not 7. Task sase-dc's four tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py nodes were closed as superseded into this bead because they are the same defect class, not a contention flake.

VERIFICATION RUN (serial, -n 0, so no xdist contention):
  .venv/bin/pytest -q -n 0 -m visual tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_help_panel.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_navigation.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py
  -> 11 failed, 12 passed in 57.56s

All 7 nodes this bead already named failed, and so did all 4 sase-dc nodes:
  test_real_fakey_retry_countdown_png_snapshot
  test_real_loader_plan_family_retry_countdown_png_snapshot
  test_real_fakey_running_fallback_png_snapshot
  test_real_fakey_completed_retry_chain_png_snapshot

MATERIAL-DIFF EVIDENCE (all well above the alpha-aware distance-8 material threshold, none of it scattered anti-aliasing noise, so none of it belongs to the retired sase-dl renderer-variance class):
  artifacts_split x4: 9.78%, 8.63%, 8.29%, 9.24% material pixels (structural pane-split change)
  help_panel filter: 681/1520532 = 0.0448% (matches this bead's original measurement exactly)
  models_panel_navigation x2: 0.0909% and 0.0911% (single-label text shapes)
  retry_e2e: 0.3235% and 4.5214% (chrome/text, not noise)

The same DO-NOT constraints apply to the four added nodes: rebaseline only after confirming each diff is explained by a landed UI change, update only the named goldens, and never run 'just test-visual-update' broadly (closed sase-lo).

Closed by epic sase-ns.6.6.6 phase sase-ns.6.6.6.2, commit 24481abd4. All eleven goldens this bead owned (its original seven plus the four inherited from sase-dc) were rebaselined only after each drift was attributed to a landed UI change: artifacts_split x4 to 278cc810b flag-bead chrome (the 120x40 trio also still carried 3f5378aeb pane-contract drift); help_keymaps_filter to 278cc810b 'Create task bead' -> 'Create bead' (681/1520532 px); models_panel x2 to 278cc810b's History footer hint moving after Back; retry_e2e to the 3c9df1182 grouping key (o)->(B), plus 49be5b0d3 family-as-one-node counts for plan_family and the 0f63a62ab launch-default pill plus F-fork keymap for completed_chain. Two retry_e2e nodes (countdown, running_fallback) were state failures rather than pixel drift: normalize_visual_timestamps rewrote running.json/agent_meta to sentinel PID 4242 without refreshing the persistent artifact index the TUI's first load now prefers, so live rows loaded as FAILED or vanished; fixed by calling update_agent_artifact_index_for_marker_mutation after the rewrite (tests/fakey/harness.py + tests/fakey/test_harness.py).

LAND-AGENT RE-VERIFICATION on master 5e58fb1c8 (workspace sase_16, from-scratch just install), which matters because roughly twenty ACE UI commits landed after the 06:25 rebaseline (b8d26eb03 artifacts relations rail, 442d8711d grouping-cycle o/O and open-externally E, 7202e847b gear iconography, 6bd5d5722 procs pane header counts, eefc44983 and 48d8897c3 family monitor nesting, c4a29f213 unread markers, 26fefdab7 new Procs goldens) and could have re-staled these goldens:

  .venv/bin/pytest -q -n 0 -m visual tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_help_panel.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel_navigation.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_retry_e2e.py
  -> 23 passed in 58.68s

Serial, so contention is excluded. All eleven are green and none needed a second rebaseline. git show --stat 24481abd4 confirms the commit touched exactly the eleven PNGs plus the harness fix, with no golden outside the eleven modified. Follow-up filed as sase-os: those four artifacts_split nodes never call select_entry_target, so their goldens capture the no-selection empty-details frame and the split widths cover no selected detail.
